freeHint: Your plan includes a free building boost
unpricedHint: getproperty has not published a price yet. The price appears here once it is on sale.
noWallet: Every purchase is an invoice on your subscription page — nothing is prepaid or kept as credit, and an unpaid invoice never suspends your account.

page.title: Promotion & photo services
page.description: Put listings and buildings in the sponsored slots of the search, and order verified or 360° photos.

listing.title: Promote this listing
listing.description: Shown in the sponsored slots on top of matching search results, always labelled "Ad".
listing.notLive: A listing can be promoted while it is published and visible on the site.

boost.title: Listing boost
boost.buyBody: Promotes "{target}" for {duration} at {total} incl. VAT. An invoice is issued now and the boost starts once it is paid — after any boost of the same listing still running.
boost.freeBody: Promotes "{target}" for {duration} at no charge, starting now.
boost.bought: Invoice issued — the boost starts once it is paid
boost.waiting: Starts once the invoice is paid
boost.mineHint: State, window and invoice of every boost
boost.howRanked: Each search page has a few sponsored slots, ranked by verified vacancy, then freshness. Listing pages and owner pages carry none.
boost.emptyHint: Boost a listing from its page, or a whole building from this page.
boost.buildingHint: Every listing of yours in the building gets a sponsored slot for one month.
boost.listingHint: Open the listing you want to promote and buy it there.

media.title: Photo services
media.pageHint: A partner photographer visits the room; the files arrive in the unit's documents and count towards your storage. Order from a listing's page.

what.verified_photo: A photographer shoots the real room, so the photos match it
what.tour_360: A 360° tour renters can walk through online

media.orderBody: For "{listing}" at {total} incl. VAT. An invoice is issued now; once it is paid our team books the visit with you.
media.noteHint: e.g. convenient times, or who to call before entering
media.waitingBooking: Paid — our team is booking the photographer
media.delivered: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} delivered to the unit's documents
media.emptyHint: Order from a listing's page once the service is on sale.

posts.title: Facebook Page posts
posts.description: Published listings are posted on your Page automatically, edited when the rent changes and removed once let.
posts.emptyQueued: No post yet — it goes up within a few minutes
posts.emptyNotLive: Posted once the listing is published
posts.autoPostOff: Automatic posting is off for your Page
posts.noPageHint: Connect your Page and every listing you publish is posted there.

next.update: Updating the post with the new details

posts.pageFailing: Your Facebook Page is not working — posting has stopped until it is fixed

facebook.title: Facebook Page
facebook.description: Post your listings on your own Page automatically.
facebook.connectHint: Enter the Page ID and a Page access token from Meta. We check them with Facebook before saving, and never show the token again.
facebook.pageIdHint: The number on the Page's About tab
facebook.tokenHint: Created in Meta Business Suite by an admin of the Page
facebook.autoPostHint: Published → posted · rent changed → post edited · let or closed → post removed
facebook.replaceNote: The current Page is disconnected; posts already on it stay.
facebook.revokeBody: Nothing more is posted on this Page and waiting posts are dropped. Posts already on the Page stay — manage them on Facebook.
facebook.emptyHint: Connect your Facebook Page and published listings are posted there automatically.
facebook.failingHint: Create a new Page access token and connect the Page again, or check again once the Page role is fixed. Nothing is posted meanwhile.

how.title: How to connect
how.step1: Open Meta Business Suite with an account that administers the Page
how.step2: Create a Page access token allowed to manage the Page's posts
how.step3: Copy the Page ID and the token into "Connect Page"
how.step4: Leave auto-post on and follow each post on the listing's page

facebook.what: Posts use the Thai caption of the share kit with the Page's own tracking link, so clicks and enquiries from the Page are counted separately.
facebook.groupsTitle: Facebook groups and Marketplace stay manual
facebook.groupsBody: Facebook does not allow automatic posts in groups or on Marketplace. Use a listing's share kit to copy the caption and download the photos.
facebook.tokenSafety: The token is encrypted with your company's key, never shown again and never written to logs or the audit trail.
